01

Archpass Overview

Seasonal mission reward track

Archpass is a seasonal mission reward track with free and premium rewards. It connects character activity to a pass-style progression lane, while premium access adds account-wide bonuses for the duration of the pass.

90

Premium Duration

Premium lasts 90 days or until the pass resets, whichever comes first.

90 days
10

Mission Resets

Chosen missions can be reset up to 10 times per week.

10 weekly
5

Talent Points

ArchPass completion grants 5 Talent Points in the current Talent Point source list.

5 Talent Points

Premium Bonuses

Premium bonusValue

03

Reward Track

Free, premium, and heirloom lanes
  • Free rewards can be claimed without premium access.
  • Premium rewards require Premium Archpass, purchased through the Living Token Trader in the current source page.
  • Exclusive pass rewards can be heirloom and return in future eras.
